name: Harare
description: Start and end of the loop.

name: Chipinda Pools
description: Gonarezhou National Park, northern section. Campsite on the Runde River near the park HQ.

name: Swimuwini Chalets / Mabalauta
description: Gonarezhou southern section. Rest camp with thatched chalets overlooking the Mwenezi River, 8 km from the Mabalauta warden's office.

name: Sango / Chicualacuala border
description: Zimbabwe (Sango) to Mozambique (Chicualacuala) crossing, south-east of Gonarezhou.

name: Tofo Beach
description: Praia do Tofo, Inhambane. Beach, diving, whale sharks.

name: Chimoio
description: Capital of Manica province. Last stop before the Zimbabwe border.

name: Machipanda / Forbes border
description: Mozambique (Machipanda) to Zimbabwe (Forbes, Mutare) crossing on the Beira corridor.
